summary: Exelixis filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 earnings and announcing a new stock repurchase authorization of up to $750 million by December 31, 2027. The board authorized the buyback, enhancing existing capital return programs. No specific price or premium is stated. The program is open-market, with mechanics typical of discretionary repurchases. The filing is primarily an earnings release with a supplementary buyback announcement. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on share count and EPS.
